# Google Cloud Generative AI Leader Study Guide

> An exam-aligned study guide for the Google Cloud Generative AI Leader certification, published by RBX Labs.

## Primary resource

- [Study guide](https://rbx-labs.io/GAIL/): Generative AI fundamentals, Google Cloud product selection, prompting and grounding, governance, agentic systems, comparisons, and scenario practice.

## Key answers

- Generative AI creates new content such as text, images, code, audio, and video.
- Grounding connects an answer to verifiable information. RAG retrieves relevant information, adds it to the model context, and generates an answer.
- Product selection should start with the user's work context, required output, source data, and delivery environment.

## Scope

This resource is study material, not an official Google Cloud exam or a source of leaked exam questions. Verify exam scope and current product names against the official Google Cloud exam guide.
